_fixture_note.curve: V-CURVE/samples/curve_today.csv — rate, channel, term, page_effective_date, source_url, grade text, read_at. Blank page_effective_date rows are omitted (out of the demo).
_fixture_note.wider: X-TF/samples/rates_all_banks.csv — banks absent from curve_today.csv. A row is kept only when effective_date_source is not an aggregator stamp and not 'none found'. Where both files print a rate, curve_today.csv is the displayed rate.
_fixture_note.codes: URL code is the CONTRACT short code when the CSV name is Vietcombank, BIDV, VietinBank, Agribank, Techcombank, MB, ACB, VPBank, Sacombank, HDBank or OCB. Every other code is the CSV bank name uppercased. ticker, ownership and listed are blank because those four files do not state them. profile is null: FiinQuant aggregates are not in the four source files.
_fixture_note.law: V-LAW/LAW.md — ceiling 4.75% (Quyết định 2411/QĐ-NHNN Điều 1, hiệu lực 20/11/2024, kỳ hạn 1 tháng đến dưới 6 tháng); cap 350000000 (Thông tư 05/2026/TT-NHNN Điều 3, hiệu lực 13/7/2026); premium 0.15% (Thông tư 04/2026/TT-NHNN Điều 4 khoản 1).
_fixture_note.policy: B-POLICY/POLICY.md §3 — depositors_pct 93.68 and value_pct 19.06 are the State Bank assessment of the 350 million option on the 31/12/2025 stock, pre-issuance, not a recount after 13/7/2026. Basis text is that sentence.
_fixture_note.ceiling_stats: Counted on non-contested, blank-tier rows in this fixture. quotes_1_5m / at_ceiling / above use terms 1 through 5. jump_5_6_pp_median is the median of (6-month rate minus 5-month rate) per bank and channel that has both terms. Contested rows are excluded from the jump.
_fixture_note.geo: Copied from data/lake/ratewatch/gold/geo_provinces.json (M1). Population and population_period in that file come from engine/vlkit/ratewatch/geo/population_2024.csv. deposits_bn stays null. Branch codes follow scenarios/ratewatch/banks.yaml.
